Gets a list of all registered commands.

RegisterSlashModuleAsync(DiscordClient client, BaseCommandModule module, ulong applicationId, Nullable<ulong> guildId)

Scans a module for -decorated methods, registers each discovered command with the Discord API, and wires the interaction handlers automatically.

ParameterDescription
clientThe Discord client.
moduleThe command module to scan.
applicationIdThe bot application ID used to register commands with Discord.
guildIdWhen non-null, commands are registered as guild-scoped (instant propagation, ideal during development). Pass to register as global commands (may take up to one hour to propagate to all clients).

BulkRegisterSlashModulesAsync(DiscordClient client, IEnumerable<BaseCommandModule> modules, ulong applicationId, Nullable<ulong> guildId)

Scans every module in for -decorated methods, registers all discovered commands with Discord in a single bulk-overwrite call, then wires all interaction handlers. Prefer this over calling per module on startup — it uses one REST round-trip instead of N, avoiding rate limits.

ParameterDescription
clientThe Discord client.
modulesThe command modules to scan.
applicationIdThe bot application ID.
guildIdWhen non-null, registers commands as guild-scoped (instant propagation, ideal for development). Pass to register as global commands (up to one hour propagation).

Properties

CommandErrored

Invoked when a command throws an unhandled exception. Assign a handler here to customise error reporting (e.g. send a user-facing error message). If no handler is assigned, the exception is logged at Error level and swallowed.
